title: MAGNET, SHIELD BUBBLE AND SCREEN CLEAR
why: The other three power-ups he said yes to join the drops. MAGNET (20 seconds) pulls the loose wrecks and bodies that still hold something, and the pickups on the floor, toward you from about fifty metres, and they stop at your feet; a wreck never slides through a wall or out of a shut room, and not while you are searching it. SHIELD BUBBLE (10 seconds) puts a bubble round you that takes every hit, a round, a blast or a fire, with a flash and a ping. SCREEN CLEAR is the nuke of the Zombies power-ups: a pulse leaves you and every ordinary machine on the screen dies. Bosses, elites, wardens and pillagers are not touched, and the machines it kills count for no streak and no kill, so the clear pays a flat thirty for each, up to four hundred. Each has its own colour, its own glyph and its own note, and no voice.
now: Three more power-ups drop: a magnet, a shield bubble and a screen clear.
